summary: MMX/3DNow! 2-component vector normalizer. Reads a packed pair at a2, squares both lanes, horizontally adds them (pfacc) into both lanes to form the squared magnitude, computes a reciprocal square-root estimate (pfrsqrt), guards against a near-zero magnitude with a packed compare against the constant 0x80000000800000, refines the estimate with one Newton-Raphson step (pfrsqit1/pfrcpit2), and writes the masked normalized pair to a1. Exits MMX state with _m_femms() on entry and before returning a1. The packet's structural-twin prelabel identifies sub_520F69 (00520f69) as an equivalent routine, and the LEGACY ABI lead labels the logic SIMD/3DNow vector normalization; both callers (Media3DNowMathOperation, SIMDQuaternionRotationArithmetic) use it to normalize a packed pair in place.

local_names.a2: input pair (two __m64 slots; low lane read as m64_u64, high lane low word read as m64_u32[0])
local_names.v4: squared magnitude after pfacc (duplicated in both lanes)
local_names.v6: packed compare mask (magnitude above threshold); zeroes out lanes below the guard

operations.description: Execute _m_femms() on entry to leave MMX state and restore x87-style FPU operation.
Load the second component: v2 = cvtsi32_si64(a2[1].m64_u32[0]) from the high pair slot at this+0x8.
Square both components packed: v3 = pfadd(pfmul(a2->m64_u64, a2->m64_u64), pfmul(v2, v2)) reading the low pair slot at this+0x0.
Horizontal add: v4 = pfacc(v3, v3) so both lanes hold the squared magnitude (x*x + y*y).
Reciprocal square-root estimate v5 = pfrsqrt(v4) (3DNow! approximate 1/sqrt).

Zero-guard compare: v6 = pfcmpgt(v4, 0x80000000800000) masks lanes whose squared magnitude is at or below the threshold (near-zero vector); qword_5AF970 is flagged read by the packet and is presumed to hold this comparison constant (rendered inline by Hex-Rays), but that mapping is not directly evidenced.
Newton-Raphson refinement of the reciprocal square root: v8 = pfrcpit2(pfrsqit1(v4, pfmul(v5, v5)), v5).
Write the normalized low lane: a1->m64_u64 = pfmul(pand(a2->m64_u64, v6), v8) (input masked by the zero-guard, scaled by the refined 1/sqrt).
Write the normalized high lane: a1[1].m64_i32[0] = cvtsi64_si32(pfmul(pand(v2, v6), v8)) into the output pair slot at this+0x8.
Execute _m_femms() and return the output pointer a1.

clean_pseudocode: // MMX/3DNow! normalize of a 2-component packed pair. a1 = output, a2 = input.
s = pfadd(pfmul(a2->m64_u64, a2->m64_u64), pfmul(y, y)); // (x*x, y*y)
s = pfacc(s, s);                          // both lanes = x*x + y*y
r = pfrcpit2(pfrsqit1(s, pfmul(r, r)), r); // Newton refinement
a1->m64_u64      = pfmul(pand(a2->m64_u64, active), r);  // normalized x
a1[1].m64_i32[0] = cvtsi64_si32(pfmul(pand(y, active), r)); // normalized y
